summary: aws lane fix round: all 7 reviewer findings confirmed and fixed, with regression tests where testable. Proxy: a client aborting its upload no longer marks nodes bad or triggers resends (Replay::client_failed); more broadly a broken connection never marks a node bad (only failed connects do), and a broken read is resent once to another node (per-request avoid), closing the corrupt-gzip and keep-alive-race variants too; 503s over 64 KiB pass through whole (peek + Prefixed body); the owner cache learns only from REST answers past the credential check (not 401/403/503) and from refusals, never from control-API answers. Template: Lambda ImageConfig sets Command [--lambda] (new search-proxy --lambda flag) and a unit test parses the template's command against the Dockerfile CMD; ToZeroPolicy step is MetricIntervalLowerBound 0; EC2 nodes get a separate gp3 data volume (/dev/xvdb, NodeCacheGiB) mounted by user data at /var/lib/roll-search and bind-mounted to /data, root volume fixed at 30 GiB, distinctInstance placement, the previous task's WAL dir removed at start, cache = disk - max(10%, 2 GiB), NodeCacheGiB 21-200. rolld: the whole SIGTERM stop is bounded by --search-shutdown-timeout (drain = total - min(total/4, 15 s), the rest for metering/leaving/connections). cfn-lint clean, clippy clean, all tests green, both YAML suites 0 regressions.
public_api: search_proxy::replay::Replay::client_failed(&self) -> bool (new). search-proxy CLI: --lambda (explicit Lambda runtime mode; requires --lambda-upstream / ROLL_SEARCH_LAMBDA_UPSTREAM). Proxy behaviour: Outcome::Broken no longer marks nodes bad; read-only resend after a broken connection is capped at 1 (MAX_BROKEN_RETRIES) and avoids the broken node; 401/403 and control-API answers don't update the owner cache. rolld: Search::shutdown(&self) -> tokio::time::Instant (deadline for the last connections; was ()), pub fn search::stop_phases(total: Duration) -> (drain, tail). Template: NodeCacheGiB MinValue 21 / MaxValue 200; EC2 data volume /dev/xvdb at /var/lib/roll-search bound to /data; NodeService PlacementConstraints distinctInstance (ec2); ProxyFunction ImageConfig Command [--lambda]. docs/search/contracts.md updated (rolld stop budget, search-proxy retries/owner cache/--lambda).
done: Finding 1 (critical, client abort marks nodes bad): confirmed. crates/search-proxy/src/replay.rs: Replay::client_failed(). crates/search-proxy/src/proxy.rs: after send, a non-response outcome with client_failed() returns 400 parse_exception without marking or retrying; resendable() is false once the client's body failed. Went further: Outcome::Broken never marks a node bad (a client can provoke a broken connection, e.g. a corrupt gzip body search-server drops the connection over, and a kept-alive connection closed by the node as a request goes out is benign); only connect failures (NotSent) mark nodes bad. A broken read-only request is resent at most once (MAX_BROKEN_RETRIES) and to another node when one exists (choose(..., avoid)). Tests: a_client_abandoning_its_upload_blames_no_node (POST _doc and _search with content-length 100000, 5 bytes, hang up: live() keeps both nodes, retries 0, next request < 1 s; verified failing on the old code), a_broken_read_is_resent_once, dead_and_broken_nodes updated, replay unit tests extended.

Finding 5 (minor, >64 KiB 503 replaced): confirmed. proxy.rs peek() reads up to PEEK_503; a larger 503 without an owner header goes to the client as the peeked bytes followed by the rest of the stream (Prefixed body); hop-by-hop headers are stripped on that path. Test a_large_503_reaches_the_client_whole (100 B, 100 KB, 3 MiB; verified failing on the old code).

Finding 6 (minor, 401 re-points owner cache): confirmed (search-server answers every pre-admission failure with 401). confirms_owner(status) excludes 401/403/503, and only Port::Rest answers are remembered (control API nodes forward to the owner themselves, so their answers never named the owner either; that was a second instance of the same bug). Test bad_credentials_and_api_answers_never_move_the_owner.

Finding 2 (major, Lambda runs `search-proxy rolld`): confirmed by reasoning (Lambda passes image CMD to an overridden entrypoint). Template ImageConfig now { EntryPoint: [/usr/local/bin/search-proxy], Command: [--lambda] }; search-proxy gained --lambda (errors clearly without an upstream). Unit test the_lambda_function_sets_a_command_this_binary_takes reads deploy/search/aws/roll-search.yaml and deploy/search/Dockerfile and parses the command line (and checks `rolld` alone fails).
Finding 3 (major, scale-to-zero step never matches): confirmed per documented bound semantics. ToZeroPolicy StepAdjustments [{ MetricIntervalLowerBound: 0, ScalingAdjustment: 0 }], with a comment.

Finding 4 (major, EC2 cache on root volume): confirmed. Launch template: root /dev/xvda fixed 30 GiB, new encrypted gp3 /dev/xvdb sized NodeCacheGiB; user data (set -euo pipefail) finds the volume (/dev/xvdb link, else the one blank unpartitioned unmounted disk), mkfs.xfs, fstab by UUID with nofail, mounts /var/lib/roll-search, chown 10001; it exits before joining the cluster if no volume is found. Task def: host volume bound to /data on EC2 only; service PlacementConstraints distinctInstance on EC2. Node command removes /data/search/cache/wal (an earlier task's WAL, named by another node id; acked writes are already in S3 with sync_objects) and sizes the cache as GiB - max(GiB/10, 2). NodeCacheGiB MinValue 21, MaxValue 200. User data checked with bash -n; arithmetic checked with dash.

Finding 7 (minor, 130 s stop vs 120 s StopTimeout): confirmed. crates/rolld/src/search.rs: Search::shutdown bounds everything (control.shutdown_within(drain) under timeout_at(deadline)) and returns the deadline; stop_phases(total) = (total - min(total/4, 15 s), tail). main.rs waits for the REST server only until that deadline (was a further 30 s). Template 100 s -> 85 s drain + 15 s tail inside StopTimeout 120. Unit test a_stop_fits_its_timeout; search_fleet SIGTERM test still green.

Docs: docs/search/deploy-aws.md (proxy retry/owner-cache rules, SIGTERM budget, NodeCacheGiB row, scale-to-zero step note, test list, Lambda image config), docs/search/contracts.md (rolld stop budget, search-proxy retries/owner cache/--lambda), template comments.
remaining: Never deployed to AWS (no credentials): the first real deploy should check the EC2 data-volume user data (device detection on Graviton/AL2023, mount before the ECS agent starts tasks), distinctInstance with managed scaling during deploys (MaximumPercent 200 needs extra instances), the Lambda Command [--lambda] override, the ToZeroPolicy actually scaling to 0, and Spot draining inside 120 s.
deploy/queues/aws/roll-queues.yaml:623 has the same MetricIntervalUpperBound: 0 step bug (not my product; left for the queues lane).

search-server drops the connection without answering on a corrupt gzip request body (Inflate::Corrupt -> DropConnection); Elasticsearch-compatible behaviour may be a 400. The proxy no longer penalises nodes for it, but a 400 would be nicer (server lane).
No committed image smoke test exists (the earlier one lived in /tmp); the Lambda command is covered by a unit test that reads the template and Dockerfile instead.
Carried over: rolling upgrade from a pre-api_tls fleet (upgrade proxies first); forced unload refuses in-flight writes with 503; Lambda TLS seed readable via lambda:GetFunctionConfiguration.
tests: search-proxy: 42 unit + 2 main + 17 integration green (4 new integration tests, 1 new main test; the client-abort and large-503 tests verified failing on the old code). search-control: 23 unit + 12 control + 9 fleet green. rolld: 3 unit + search_fleet 1/1 green. cargo clippy --no-deps --all-targets -D warnings clean for search-proxy, search-control, rolld, roll-cli. cfn-lint (roll-aws-cfnlint image) clean, and it catches an injected error. YAML (ROLL_PORT=19600, ROLL_JOBS=8): ES 3905 tests, 3809 passed / 1 failed / 95 skipped, 0 baseline regressions (the failure is search.vectors knn profile, search-es); OpenSearch 1506 tests, 1455 passed / 0 failed / 51 skipped, 0 regressions.
notes_for_others: queues lane: deploy/queues/aws/roll-queues.yaml:623 uses StepAdjustments [{ MetricIntervalUpperBound: 0 }] with a GreaterThanOrEqualToThreshold alarm on a 0/1 expression; no step matches the breach value, so use MetricIntervalLowerBound: 0 (fixed the same way in roll-search.yaml ToZeroPolicy).

server lane: search-server http.rs answers a corrupt gzip/deflate request body by dropping the connection (Inflate::Corrupt -> DropConnection). The proxy no longer marks nodes bad for broken connections, but answering 400 would match Elasticsearch better and let clients see an error.
rolld's Search::shutdown() now returns a tokio::time::Instant (deadline for remaining connections); callers that ignore it are fine.
search-proxy has a new --lambda flag; the Lambda function's ImageConfig Command is [--lambda]. Keep deploy/search/Dockerfile CMD ["rolld"] or update the unit test in crates/search-proxy/src/main.rs.
